layer_error_complementarity.thresholds: per-row thresholds were fixed on that row's outer-training inner dev

matrix_conventions.directed_rescue: cell [i,j] is count/rate of layer i correct among errors made by layer j
matrix_conventions.directed_rescue_zero_denominator: rate is 0 when layer j has no errors
matrix_conventions.error_jaccard_zero_union: value is 0 when neither layer makes an error
matrix_conventions.oracle_pair_accuracy: fraction correct by at least one of layers i and j

layer_curve_scope: outer-held diagnostic curve; best layer was chosen independently on each inner dev
stop_conditions: Any A/B or outer-fold leakage: stop and invalidate results
Nonfinite features/loss/gradients or mismatched capacity/init: stop
Do not expand training seeds to manufacture a positive screening result
